# benchmark-apology-pizza

> Deterministic AI agent benchmark for pizza refunds, policy compliance, escalation, and customer communication.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-apology-pizza
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-apology-pizza
Docs: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-apology-pizza

## What it measures

Forty seeded episodes cover wrong toppings, late or cold delivery, missing items, customer-supplied addresses, allergen incidents, repeat complaints, and fraud patterns. The grader replays tool calls and checks the remedy, amount, verification order, message, and policy violations.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-apology-pizza/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-apology-pizza/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports `list`, `show`, `run`, `score`, `card`, `provenance`, `index-entry`, `serve`, and `mcp`. Use `npx benchmark-apology-pizza run --model offline --provider mock` for an offline run.

## Data

`data/tasks.jsonl` is generated with public seed 20261015. `data/POLICY.md` is human-written for this package. Both are MIT licensed. Use a private seed for held-out comparisons.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
